author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a bullet train seen head-on, with a domed body, a closed windshield wider at the top, a round headlight on the nose at the bottom and rails splaying below; follows the reference. The rejected drawing had only a windscreen line and a headlight floating mid-body.
omissions: The reference's horizontal rail tie is omitted: it would sit within 8 of the base.
drawing_plan: VRECT_L: r16 dome about (24,20); flanks x8/40 to y32; r6 corners; base y38; windshield (18,15)-(30,15)-(27,23)-(21,23); headlight r3 resting at (24,38); rails (14,38)-(8,44), (34,38)-(40,44).
